# Accepted dependency advisories for the CI pip-audit gate.
#
# One advisory ID per line; `pip-audit --ignore-vuln <ID>` is passed for each.
# Lines starting with `#` and blank lines are ignored.
#
# Policy: the gate must stay RED for anything not listed here, so every entry
# needs a one-line reason. Entries are transitive ML dependencies (transformers
# / accelerate / ragas and its diskcache), where an upgrade means a major-line
# bump that only the RAG / local-inference skills can validate; setuptools is a
# locked build-time dependency whose fix (83.0.0) rides a future lock refresh.
# Re-check this list whenever uv.lock is upgraded.

PYSEC-2026-3447  # setuptools — fix is 83.0.0; waits for the next lock refresh
